app.title: ETS2 Mod Manager By Himeno Sena
ui.sb_enabled_count: {en}/{tot} mods enabled.   Table order = load order (top→bottom). Lower rows override upper ones.  Profile: {prof}
ui.btn_repair: 🔧 Repair broken link (re-select real dir on H:)…
ui.ph_desc:
Mod description:
  - Loads mod_description.txt (SCS color tags are simplified)
  - Falls back to manifest author / version if missing
ui.tb_preset: ✨ Apply recommended order (map bottom / assets mid / features top)
sym.normal:
📂 Mod directory is a normal folder (not migrated, on C:)
  {link}
sym.broken:
⚠️ Symlink / Junction is BROKEN! (original target no longer exists)
  Location: {link}
  You previously cut the real dir to another drive (e.g. H:) but the link was not updated.
  Please click the red 『🔧 Repair…』 button below and re-select the real mod directory.
sym.not_found: ⚠️ Mod directory not found (click 『🔀 Move to another drive…』 below to create and point to a new location)
menu.assign_category: 🏷  Assign checked table rows to this category
dlg.hint_select_rows: Please select 1 or more rows first (Ctrl+A to select all).
dlg.preset_msg:
Applied recommended order:
  • Map / region mods: bottom (load first)
  • Asset / model packs: middle
  • Weather / AI / sound / trucks etc.: top (load last, override assets)
Press Ctrl+Z or adjust manually if you prefer a different order.
dlg.no_profile_save: Please select a profile on the left first.
dlg.no_profile_backup: Please select a profile on the left first.
dlg.save_confirm_msg:
About to write {prof}…:
Total enabled mods: {n}.

profile.sii will be auto-backed up before writing, and verified after.
Proceed?
dlg.save_fail_msg:
Write-back failed: {e}

If your profile.sii uses the new SCS encryption (ScsCryption signature), please place SII_Decrypt.exe at assets/bin/SII_Decrypt.exe and retry.
dlg.backup_skip_msg: Content is 100% identical to the latest backup; no duplicate was created.
dlg.assign_hint_msg: First select rows in the right table (Ctrl+click / Ctrl+A), then right-click a category folder → Assign.
dlg.lo_no_profile: Please select a profile in the left panel first.
dlg.lo_empty: Profile 「{prof}」 does not have any mods enabled.
dlg.lo_html_count: {n} mods enabled (top → bottom = loaded first → later override)
dlg.nm_title: {n} new mod(s) found — please choose category folders
dlg.nm_info:
{n} new mod(s) found this scan. Please assign them to 『Category Folders』:
(defaults to Uncategorized; later you can right-click a folder on the left → 『Assign selected rows』 to batch-modify at any time)
dlg.relocate_pick: Select or create a folder (will be the real mod storage directory)
dlg.relocate_confirm_msg:
All contents of the original mod dir ({orig})
will be moved to:
  {dest}

Then a Junction (or Symlink) will be created at the original location, pointing to the new dir. The game will read transparently. Continue?
dlg.unlink_confirm_msg: This will remove the current symlink/Junction and move the real directory back to its original location (from the target dir). Continue?
dlg.repair_pick: Select the real mod dir you cut to (e.g. H:\Euro Truck Simulator 2 mod)
dlg.repair_ok_hint: Next step: click 『🔄 Rescan Mods』 on the toolbar to reload local mods (the symlink now points to the new drive).
detail.author: Author: {v}
detail.missing_file: ⚠️ Real file not found in mod dir / Workshop (symlink broken or mod deleted)
sym.msg_same_orig_target: Source and target directories must be different
sym.msg_move_error: Error moving files (aborted; files are intact): {e}
sym.msg_replace_orig_fail: Cannot replace original dir, please delete {orig} manually and retry: {e}
sym.msg_junction_ok: Migration complete. A Junction was created. The game will read transparently, no reboot required.
sym.msg_symlink_ok: Migration complete. A Symlink was created via os.symlink.
sym.msg_unlink_not_needed: Current mod dir status is '{kind}' — nothing to undo.
sym.msg_unlink_no_target: Cannot identify the target dir (or it no longer exists); unable to undo.
sym.msg_unlink_moveback_fail: Error moving files back: {e}. The real directory is currently at {target}; you may copy it manually.
sym.msg_unlink_ok: Migration undone. Real directory has been restored to the original location.
sym.msg_repair_target_invalid: Target directory does not exist or is not a folder: {target}
sym.msg_repair_del_fail: Failed to delete the old link: {e}
sym.msg_repair_clear_fail: Cannot remove old link/dir at the original location: {orig}. Please delete it manually and retry.
sym.msg_repair_jct_ok: Broken link repaired: a Junction now points → {target}. Restart ETS2 for changes to take effect.
sym.msg_repair_sym_ok: Broken link repaired: a Symlink now points → {target}. Restart ETS2 for changes to take effect.
